title: A New English Teacher
passage: It is Monday morning. The students are in the classroom. Ms Li is their new English teacher. She says, "Good morning, class!" The students say, "Good morning, Ms Li!" Ms Li asks Amy, "What's your name?" Amy says, "My name is Amy." Then Ms Li asks Daming. Daming says, "I'm Daming. Nice to meet you!" Ms Li smiles. She says, "Welcome to our school! Now stand up, please. Open your books." The students stand up and open their books. They are very happy on the first day of school.
passageZh: 这是星期一的早上。学生们在教室里。李老师是他们的新英语老师。她说："早上好，同学们！"学生们说："早上好，李老师！"李老师问艾米："你叫什么名字？"艾米说："我的名字叫艾米。"然后李老师问大明。大明说："我是大明。很高兴见到您！"李老师笑了。她说："欢迎来到我们学校！现在请起立，打开你们的书。"学生们起立并打开书。开学的第一天他们非常开心。

title: Boboo the Bird
passage: Boboo is a small bird. It is the first day of school. Boboo flies to the classroom. It sees Lingling. Boboo says, "Hello! What's your name?" Lingling says, "My name is Lingling. Nice to meet you!" Boboo says, "Nice to meet you too! Let's play together after school." Lingling says, "Great! Goodbye, Boboo! Have a nice day!" Boboo flies up and smiles. It likes the new school and its new friend Lingling. They make new friends and learn to say hello and goodbye. School is fun!

title: In the Classroom
passage: It is a nice morning. The students are in the classroom. Their teacher says, "Hello, everyone! Stand up, please." The students stand up. Then the teacher says, "Open your books." The students open their books. A little boy cannot find his book. His friend helps him. The teacher says, "Good work! Now close your books. Goodbye, class!" The students say, "Goodbye, teacher! Have a nice day!" They make new friends and learn to say hello and goodbye. School is fun!

title: Greetings at School
passage: When you meet your teacher at school in the morning, you can say "Good morning!". When you meet a new friend, you can say "Hello! What's your name?". The new friend says, "My name is Tom. Nice to meet you!". You can say, "Nice to meet you too!". When school is over, you can say "Goodbye! Have a nice day!". In class, the teacher says "Stand up!" and "Open your books!". You listen carefully. English greetings are easy and fun!

title: Welcome to Our School
passage: Today is the first day of the new term. There are many new students at the school gate. A teacher smiles and says, "Welcome to our school!". A girl says, "Hello! My name is Lily. What's your name?". A boy says, "I'm Sam. Nice to meet you, Lily!". Lily says, "Nice to meet you too! Let's go to the classroom together!". They walk to the classroom. The teacher opens the door and says, "Stand up, please. Open your books. Let's begin!"

title: Sam and Amy
passage: Sam and Amy are twins. They are from the UK. They are nine years old. Sam is a boy and Amy is a girl. They look the same. Today they go to a new school. They meet a Chinese boy. His name is Daming. Sam says, "Hi! I'm Sam. I'm nine." Amy says, "I'm Amy. I'm nine too." Daming says, "Nice to meet you! Let's be friends!" They are very happy. They play together every day. Good friends make every day bright and happy.

title: We Are Twins
passage: Kate and Peter are twins. They are from Canada. They are ten years old. Kate is a girl. Peter is a boy. They have the same big eyes and the same small nose. But they are different. Kate likes reading. Peter likes running. Today they go to school together. They meet their new friend, Bob. Kate says, "Nice to meet you, Bob!" Bob says, "Nice to meet you too! Are you twins?" Peter says, "Yes, we are!" They play together every day. Good friends make every day bright and happy.

title: My Schoolbag
passage: Tom has a big schoolbag. It is blue. In the schoolbag, there is a book. The book is new. There is a pencil too. It is yellow. Tom also has a ruler. The ruler is long and white. One morning, Tom packs his bag for school. He puts the book, the pen and the pencil in the bag. Then he says, "Let's go to school!" His mum smiles and says, "Have a nice day!" They pack their bags carefully and never leave their books at home.

title: My Pencil Box

title: We Love Our Home
passage: This is the Wang family. Dad is tall. Mum is kind. Grandma has white hair. Lily is eight. Daming is nine. They all live in a happy home. After dinner, they sit together. Dad reads a newspaper. Mum watches TV. Grandma tells stories. Daming and Lily play cards. The family laughs a lot. Daming says, "We are a happy family! I love my home." Lily says, "Me too!" They love their family very much. A happy home is the best place in the world.

title: Long Hair or Short Hair
passage: Lily has got long hair. Her hair is black and straight. It goes down to her shoulders. Her brother Tom has got short hair. His hair is brown. Their mum has got long hair too. title: My Favourite Animal — The Rabbit
passage: My favourite animal is the rabbit. Rabbits are very cute. They have long ears and short tails. They like eating carrots. Rabbits can jump very fast. They live in holes. I often see rabbits in the zoo. I like watching them play. A rabbit can run a little, but it is best at jumping. It can hop across the grass quickly. Many children love rabbits because they are soft and quiet. Rabbits live in grassy fields and quietly eat fresh green vegetables. A good rest at night helps me start the next morning happily. Small habits like being on time make each school day smooth.

title: My Favourite Song
passage: My favourite song is "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star". It's a beautiful song. The lyrics are easy to remember. I love to sing this song before going to bed. It makes me feel relaxed. I can also listen to it on the radio. On a calm, clear night, I look at the stars and sing along. The song always makes me feel warm and quiet. My mother sings the song to me when I cannot fall asleep. The simple tune stays in my head all day. I know every word by heart and can sing it without looking. Sometimes my little brother sings along in a soft voice. A favourite song can cheer us up even on a grey, rainy day, and it becomes a warm memory we keep for years.

title: The Four Seasons
passage: There are four seasons in a year. Spring is a beautiful season. The grass turns green and the flowers come out. We can fly kites in spring. Summer is hot. We can swim in the pool. Autumn is a harvest season. The leaves on the trees turn yellow and fall down. We can pick apples. Winter is cold. Sometimes it snows. We can make a snowman. Each season is special. In spring, days grow longer and the air feels warm. Farmers work in the fields, and birds build their nests in trees. In summer, we eat cold watermelon and hide from strong sun. In autumn, farmers are busy picking fruit and storing rice. In winter, we wear thick coats and stay warm by the window. No season is boring; each one gives us a different kind of fun.

Cool wind, good fruit and family time make autumn my favourite season of the year.

title: The Zoo
passage: Last Sunday, I went to the zoo with my parents. We saw many animals there. The monkeys were very funny. They jumped and played around. The pandas were cute. They ate bamboo. The lions were strong. They walked around in their cages. We also saw giraffes with long necks. It was a great day at the zoo. We took many photos and learned a lot about animals. Before leaving, our teacher told us not to feed the animals or knock on their cages. We walked slowly and kept our voices low. The giraffes ate leaves from a tall tree, and the elephants sprayed water with their trunks. We bought small animal stickers at the gate. A zoo visit teaches us to love and protect animals, and it is a day we remember happily.

After we enter, the playground is on the left and the classroom building is straight ahead. Teachers show new visitors the way on the first day. The garden sits behind the building, full of colourful flowers. Knowing the way around school helps us find every room without getting lost.
passageZh: 我的学校很漂亮，有很多教室、一个图书馆、一个操场和一个花园。图书馆有很多书，我们可以借书。操场很大，我们可以在上面打篮球、踢足球。花园有很多花，五颜六色。老师和蔼，教我们很多东西。来我的学校时，直走，你会看到操场在左边。我们学校有长大门、宽院子和很多房间。进门后，操场在左边，教学楼在正前方。第一天老师带新访客认路。花园在楼后，开满彩色的花。熟悉校园的路，帮我们找到每个房间而不迷路。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第3篇（My School，补D项）

title: My Classroom
passage: My classroom is bright and clean. There are many desks and chairs for students. There is a blackboard at the front of the classroom. The teacher writes on it. There are some colourful pictures on the walls. We read books and have lessons in the classroom. From the door, go straight on, and the teacher's desk is in front of you. The windows let in lots of light. Our classroom faces south, so sunlight enters all morning. We wipe the desk before lessons and put chairs under the table after class. The teacher writes new words on the blackboard, and we copy them into our notebooks. Posters about words and pictures make the walls lively. A tidy, bright room helps us listen carefully and learn well.
passageZh: 我的教室明亮又干净，有很多学生桌椅。前面有一块黑板，老师在上面写字。墙上有一些彩色图画。我们在教室读书、上课。从门进去直走，讲桌就在你面前。窗户透进很多光。教室朝南，一上午都有阳光。上课前我们擦桌子，课后把椅子塞到桌下。老师把生词写在黑板上，我们抄进笔记本。单词和图画海报让墙面生动。整洁明亮的房间帮我们认真听讲、学好知识。

title: The Library Rules
passage: The library is a great place to read and study. But we must follow the rules. We should keep quiet in the library so that everyone can read without noise. We can borrow two books at a time and keep them for two weeks. We need to return the books on time. We can't write or draw on the books. If we lose the books, we have to pay for them. Walk straight in and enjoy reading. Reading in the library trains our patience and quiet manners. When we find a book, we carry it with both hands and turn pages gently. We mark our name on the library card before taking a book home. If a book is damaged, we tell the librarian instead of hiding it. Following rules lets everyone enjoy reading in a clean, peaceful library for years.
passageZh: 图书馆是阅读学习的好地方，但我们必须遵守规则。要保持安静，让大家不受打扰地阅读。一次可以借两本书，借两周，需要按时归还。不能在书上写字或画画。如果弄丢书，必须赔偿。走进去，享受阅读吧。在图书馆阅读培养耐心和安静的举止。找到书后，我们双手捧着，轻轻翻页。把书带回家前，我们在借书卡上写名字。书损坏时，我们告诉管理员而不是藏起来。遵守规则，让大家多年都能在干净安宁的图书馆阅读。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第24篇（The Library Rules，补D项）

title: My Favourite Animal — The Panda
passage: My favourite animal is the panda. Pandas are very cute. They are black and white. Pandas live in bamboo forests. They like to eat bamboo. Pandas are very lazy. They spend most of their time sleeping. But they are very popular all over the world. When you walk into the zoo, go straight on and turn left, and you will find the panda house. Pandas spend most of the day eating bamboo and resting on soft branches. They move slowly, but they can climb trees when they want. Visitors walk along a wooden path and watch from a distance. Our government protects bamboo forests so pandas have enough food. Seeing a real panda in the zoo makes every child smile, and we hope they live safely for ever.
passageZh: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。熊猫很可爱，黑白相间。它们住在竹林里，喜欢吃竹子。熊猫很懒，大部分时间在睡觉。但它们在全世界都很受欢迎。走进动物园，直走再左转，你就会找到熊猫馆。熊猫一天大部分时间吃竹子，在软树枝上休息。它们走得慢，但想爬树时也能爬。游客沿木栈道远远观看。政府保护竹林，让熊猫有足够食物。在动物园看到真熊猫让每个孩子微笑，我们希望它们永远安全生活。

title: My Family
passage: I have a happy family. My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital. He likes reading books. My mother is a teacher. She teaches English in a primary school. She likes cooking delicious food for us. I am a student. I like playing football. On weekends, we often go to the park together. We fly a kite and have a picnic there. We enjoy our time together. On weekends, we pack a small basket with bread and juice. We walk to the park along a quiet street and cross the road at the zebra crossing. My father flies the kite high, and my mother spreads the blanket. We watch clouds and talk about our week. A happy family makes every simple outing feel warm and full of love.
passageZh: 我有一个幸福的家。爸爸是医生，在医院工作，喜欢读书。妈妈是老师，在小学教英语，喜欢给我们做好吃的。我是学生，喜欢踢足球。周末我们常一起去公园，放风筝、野餐，享受在一起的时光。周末我们往小篮子里装面包和果汁。沿安静街道走到公园，在斑马线过马路。爸爸把风筝放高，妈妈铺开毯子。我们看云，聊聊这一周。幸福的家让每次简单出游都温暖、充满爱。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四上阅读小纸条第1篇（My Family，补D项）

title: My Family's Jobs
passage: There are four people in my family. My father is a doctor. He works in a big hospital. He helps sick people get better. My mother is a nurse. She works in the same hospital and takes care of patients. My uncle is a driver. He drives a bus from morning to night. My aunt is a teacher. She works at a primary school and loves her students. What does he do? He is a doctor. What does she do? She is a teacher. Every job is important, and we respect all workers. At the dinner table, we often talk about our day at work or school. My father tells us how he helps patients, and my mother describes the children she teaches. My uncle drives carefully even when the road is busy. Each job uses different skills, but all of them serve people. When we grow up, we may choose different jobs, yet we should always respect everyone who works.
passageZh: 我家有四口人。爸爸是医生，在大医院工作，帮助病人康复。妈妈是护士，在同一家医院照顾病人。叔叔是司机，从早到晚开公交车。姑姑是老师，在小学工作，爱她的学生。他是做什么的？他是医生。她是做什么的？她是老师。每份工作都重要，我们尊重所有劳动者。晚饭桌上，我们常聊聊各自工作或上学的一天。爸爸讲他怎样帮助病人，妈妈讲她教的孩子。叔叔即使路忙也小心开车。每份工作技能不同，但都在服务人。长大后我们可能选不同工作，但应始终尊重每一位劳动者。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（What does he/she do? He/She is a...）

title: Night Workers
passage: Some people work at night when we sleep. A doctor works at night in the hospital and helps sick people. A nurse looks after patients through the night. A driver drives the night bus across the quiet city. A firefighter stays ready to keep us safe. They work at night so we can rest well. They keep the city safe. They love their jobs, and it feels great! We should say thank you to these night heroes. When we sleep in warm beds, these workers keep the streets lit and safe. A night doctor writes notes after each check, and a night driver greets sleepy passengers. A firefighter checks the truck every evening so it is ready. We seldom see them, but their quiet effort surrounds us. A small thank-you card or a kind word can make a night worker feel proud of the job.
passageZh: 有些人在我们睡觉时的夜里工作。医生夜里在医院帮助病人，护士整夜照顾病人，司机开夜班车穿过安静的城市，消防员随时待命保护我们安全。他们夜里工作，让我们好好休息。他们保卫城市安全，热爱工作，感觉很棒！我们应该向这些夜班英雄说谢谢。我们在暖床上睡觉时，这些工作者让街道明亮、安全。夜班医生每次检查后写记录，夜班司机向困倦乘客问好。消防员每晚检查消防车，随时待命。我们很少见到他们，但他们安静的努力围绕着我们。一张感谢卡或一句善意的话，就能让夜班工作者为工作自豪。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（He/She works at night. They keep the city safe.）

title: The Journey of Bread
passage: How does bread come to our table? First, the farmer grows wheat in the field. Then, the worker makes the wheat into flour. Next, the baker mixes the flour and bakes the bread in the oven. Finally, the driver delivers the bread to the shop. Many people work together to make one loaf of bread. Each job has a special role. Together, they make bread possible. This shows us that every worker matters. The farmer waits through rain and sun for the wheat to ripen. The worker cleans the grain before grinding it into fine flour. The baker mixes yeast, water and flour, then waits for the dough to rise. The driver checks the bread carefully before delivering it. Behind every slice of bread stand many pairs of hard-working hands, which teaches us to value food and thank workers.
passageZh: 面包怎样来到我们餐桌？首先，农民在田里种小麦；然后，工人把小麦磨成面粉；接着，面包师把面粉和好，放进烤箱烤成面包；最后，司机把面包送到商店。很多人一起努力才做出一条面包。每份工作都有特别作用，大家一起才有了面包。这告诉我们每个劳动者都重要。农民经历日晒雨淋等待小麦成熟。工人先清理谷物，再磨成细面粉。面包师把酵母、水、面粉和好，等面团发酵。司机送货前仔细检查面包。每一片面包背后都有许多双勤劳的手，这教会我们珍惜食物、感谢劳动者。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（First... Then... Next... Finally...）

title: My Dream Job
passage: I want to be a scientist when I grow up. I want to work in a lab and study plants. I work with books and tools. I love doing experiments because I want to help people. My friend Lily wants to be a painter. She works in a studio and loves drawing. My brother wants to be a pilot. He wants to fly in the sky. I believe in myself, and I will study hard to make my dream come true. In the lab, I read books about plants and write down my observations. My teacher encourages me to ask questions and never fear mistakes. Lily practises drawing every evening and hopes to paint people and nature. My brother builds paper planes and dreams of flying one day. A dream is just a wish until study and action turn it into a real goal.
passageZh: 我长大后想当科学家，想在实验室研究植物。我和书、工具打交道。我热爱做实验，因为我想帮助人们。朋友莉莉想当画家，在画室工作，热爱画画。我弟弟想当飞行员，想在天上飞。我相信自己，会努力学习实现梦想。在实验室，我读植物书，记下观察。老师鼓励我提问、不怕犯错。莉莉每晚练画，希望画人物和自然。弟弟折纸飞机，梦想有一天飞翔。梦想只是愿望，直到学习和行动把它变成真正的目标。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（I want to be a... and work in a...）

title: People in Our City
passage: Our city has many hard-working people. A farmer grows vegetables in the field. A painter draws beautiful pictures on the wall. A cook makes delicious food in the restaurant. A policeman helps people and keeps the street safe. A pilot flies a plane high in the sky. We can guess the job from clues: where they work, what tool they use, and what they do. Each person does a special job, and together our city runs well. On our city map, we match each worker to his or her workplace. A farmer's field is outside the town, a painter's studio has brushes, and a cook's kitchen smells of food. A policeman walks the beat, and a pilot sits high in the sky. Clues like place, tool and action help us guess the job. Every worker keeps the city running, so we should be thankful to them all.
passageZh: 我们城市有很多勤劳的人。农民在田里种蔬菜，画家在墙上画美丽的画，厨师在餐厅做好吃的，警察帮助人们、维护街道安全，飞行员在高空开飞机。我们可以根据线索猜职业：在哪里工作、用什么工具、做什么事。每个人做特别的工作，城市才能良好运转。在城市地图上，我们把每位工作者和工作场所配对。农民的田在城外，画家的画室有画笔，厨师的厨房飘着食物香。警察巡逻，飞行员坐在高空。场所、工具、行为等线索帮我们猜职业。每位工作者都让城市运转，我们应感谢他们所有人。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U1原创（职业词汇 + 线索推理）

title: How Do You Feel Today?
passage: Today is Monday. Daming feels sad because he can't take part in the singing show. He has a cough and he is ill. Amy feels happy because her best friend comes back to school after a long illness. Lingling feels surprised because her mum gives her a new storybook. Sam feels angry because his little brother breaks his toy car. Feelings change all the time. —How do you feel today? —I'm feeling happy. We can talk about our feelings. Feelings come and go like weather, and none of them is wrong. After seeing the doctor, Daming drinks warm water and rests at home. Amy shares her happy news with the whole class. Lingling reads her new storybook before bed. Sam's mother helps him fix the toy car, so his anger slowly melts. Talking about feelings keeps our heart light and helps friends understand us.
passageZh: 今天星期一。大明难过，因为他不能参加歌唱表演，他咳嗽生病了。埃米开心，因为她最好的朋友病了很久后回到学校。玲玲惊喜，因为妈妈送她一本新故事书。萨姆生气，因为弟弟弄坏了他的玩具汽车。情绪一直在变。——你今天感觉怎样？——我很开心。我们可以说出自己的情绪。情绪像天气一样来去，没有一种是错的。看完医生，大明喝温水在家休息。埃米把开心的消息告诉全班。玲玲睡前读新故事书。妈妈帮萨姆修好玩具车，他的生气慢慢消散。说出情绪让心情轻松，也帮朋友理解我们。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（I'm feeling... / How do you feel? 六种情绪）

title: A Surprise Party
passage: Yesterday was Lily's birthday. Her friends planned a surprise party. When Lily walked into the room, all her friends jumped out and shouted, "Happy birthday!" Lily felt very excited and surprised. She clapped her hands and smiled. She saw a big cake and many gifts. She felt happy all evening. Her mother took photos. It was a wonderful party, and nobody felt sad. Before the party, friends hid behind the door and turned off the light. Lily did not know anyone was coming, so her surprise was real. After singing the birthday song, we made a wish and blew out the candles. We kept the cake for Grandma to taste the next day. A surprise party shows how much friends care, and it leaves happy memories for years.
passageZh: 昨天是莉莉的生日，朋友们准备了惊喜派对。当莉莉走进房间，大家跳出来喊：“生日快乐！”莉莉又激动又惊喜，她拍手微笑。她看到大蛋糕和许多礼物，整晚都很开心。妈妈拍了照片。派对很棒，没人难过。派对前，朋友躲在门后，关掉灯。莉莉不知道有人来，所以惊喜很真实。唱完生日歌，我们许愿、吹蜡烛。蛋糕留到第二天给奶奶尝。惊喜派对说明朋友有多在乎，留下多年的快乐回忆。

title: Why Are You Angry?
passage: Tom was angry this morning. Why are you angry? Because his brother took his pencil case without asking. Tom's face was red, and he spoke loudly. Then his mother came and said sorry for his brother. They shared the pencils together. Tom slowly felt calm and happy again. When we are angry, we should take a deep breath and talk kindly. Being angry is OK, but we should not shout at others. After calming down, Tom helped his brother pick up the pencils. They agreed to ask before taking each other's things. His mother praised both boys for sharing. That evening, Tom drew a picture and gave it to his brother as a peace gift. When we manage anger kindly, a small quarrel can end in friendship instead of a fight.
passageZh: 汤姆今早生气。你为什么生气？因为他弟弟没问就拿走了他的铅笔盒。汤姆脸涨红，大声说话。后来妈妈替弟弟道了歉，他们一起分用铅笔。汤姆慢慢平静、又开心起来。生气时我们应深呼吸、好好说。生气很正常，但不应对别人大喊。平静后，汤姆帮弟弟捡起铅笔。他们约定拿彼此东西前先问。妈妈表扬两个孩子分享。晚上，汤姆画了一幅画送给弟弟讲和。善意处理愤怒，小争吵也能以友谊结束，而不是吵架。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（Why are you angry? Because...）

title: A Worried Test Day
passage: Today we have an English test. At first, Meimei feels worried. She thinks she can't finish the paper. Her hands are cold, and her heart beats fast. But the teacher says, "Don't worry. Take your time." Meimei takes a deep breath and reads each question carefully. She finishes the paper. When the teacher says she did well, Meimei feels happy and proud. Worry is normal, but trying our best helps. Meimei wrote her name carefully and checked each answer twice. When she finished early, she sat quietly and thought again. The test was not easy, but she did her best and that was enough. After school, she played outside to relax. Being worried is natural before a test, but confidence and careful work turn worry into calm.
passageZh: 今天有英语考试。起初美美感到担心，她觉得自己做不完试卷，手发凉、心跳快。但老师说：“别担心，慢慢来。”美美深呼吸，仔细读每道题，完成了试卷。老师说她考得好时，美美开心又自豪。担心很正常，但尽力就有帮助。美美认真写名字，把每题检查两遍。提前做完时，她安静坐着再想一遍。考试不简单，但她尽力了，这就够了。放学后她出去玩放松。考前担心很自然，但自信和认真把担心变成平静。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（worried → happy，because原因）

title: Feelings Are OK
passage: Everyone has feelings. Sometimes we feel happy, and sometimes we feel sad or angry. It is OK to feel every emotion. When we are sad, we can talk to a friend or a parent. When we are excited, we can share the joy. Reading a storybook or playing sports can also make us happy. —I feel like singing when I am happy. Sharing feelings helps us feel better. We should be kind to ourselves and to others. At school, our feelings wall shows a happy face, a sad face and an angry face. Children place a small card beside the face they feel today. The teacher never laughs at any feeling. A walk, a hug or a kind word can comfort a sad friend. When we name our feelings instead of hiding them, we grow emotionally and make kinder friends.
passageZh: 每个人都有情绪。有时开心，有时难过或生气。每种情绪都正常。难过时可以找朋友或父母聊聊，激动时可以分享喜悦。读故事书或做运动也能让我们开心。开心时我想唱歌。说出情绪让我们好起来，我们要善待自己和他人。学校里的情绪墙有开心、难过、生气的脸。孩子把小卡片放在自己今天的情绪旁边。老师从不嘲笑任何情绪。散步、拥抱或一句善言能安慰难过的朋友。说出而不是隐藏情绪，我们在情感上成长，交到更友善的朋友。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U2原创（I feel...like... / 情绪分享）

title: The School Talent Show
passage: Our school had a talent show yesterday. Lingling is good at dancing. She danced very beautifully on the stage. Amy is good at singing. She sang a sweet song. Daming is not good at dancing, but he wants to try. —What are you doing? —I'm practising the dance. Why are you doing that? Because I love dancing. At the show, everyone clapped. Everyone's got talent, and trying is the first step. Before the show, we practised on the stage in turns. Lingling's dance steps were smooth, and Amy's voice was clear. Daming watched and copied each move, even when he stepped on feet. The teacher clapped and told us that practice makes perfect. On show night, the whole hall cheered. Talent is a gift, but daily practice turns that gift into a beautiful performance.
passageZh: 我们学校昨天举办了才艺表演。玲玲擅长跳舞，在舞台上跳得很美。埃米擅长唱歌，唱了一首甜美的歌。大明不擅长跳舞，但他想试试。——你在做什么？——我在练舞。——你为什么做这个？——因为我热爱跳舞。表演上大家都鼓掌。每个人都有才能，尝试是第一步。表演前，我们轮流在舞台上练习。玲玲舞步流畅，埃米嗓音清亮。大明看着模仿每个动作，即使踩到脚。老师鼓掌说熟能生巧。表演之夜，全场欢呼。才能是天赋，但每天练习把天赋变成精彩演出。

title: Keep Trying
passage: Peter wants to learn to swim. I'm trying to swim across the small pool. At first, he puts his face in the water and feels afraid. He fails and stands up. Why? Because the water feels cold. His friend encourages him, "Keep trying — that's real talent!" Peter practises every afternoon. Little by little, he can float and then swim a little. Failures are part of learning. Today he can swim ten metres. He feels proud. Peter's coach showed him how to hold his breath and move his arms. At first, water went into his mouth, but he did not run away. He watched good swimmers and copied their breathing. His parents cheered from the poolside every afternoon. Small steps every day add up to a big change, and never giving up is what real talent is made of.
passageZh: 彼得想学游泳。我在努力游过小泳池。起初他把脸埋进水里，感到害怕，失败后站起来。为什么？因为水冷。朋友鼓励他：“不断尝试，这才是真正的才能！”彼得每天下午练习，渐渐地他能漂浮，然后游一点。失败是学习的一部分。今天他能游十米了，他很自豪。教练教彼得如何憋气、摆臂。起初水灌进嘴里，但他没有跑开。他观察优秀游泳者，模仿呼吸。每天下午父母在池边为他加油。每天一小步积累成大改变，永不放弃正是真正才能的构成。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（I'm trying to... / Keep trying — that's real talent!）

title: Kinds of Talent
passage: People have different kinds of talent. I've got picture talent — I love drawing animals. My deskmate has word talent — she writes nice stories. Tom has body talent — he jumps high and runs fast. Lily has number talent — she counts quickly. Jack has musical talent — he sings and plays the piano. What kind of talent do you have? You can find your talent by trying many things. Know your talents — that's the first step to growth! We make a talent board in class and write our names under the right kind. A child who draws well puts a star under picture talent. We interview each other and share one small strength. No talent is better than another; they are simply different. Knowing what we are good at helps us choose hobbies we truly enjoy and grow in.
passageZh: 人们有不同类型的才能。我有绘画才能——爱画动物；同桌有文字才能——写好故事；汤姆有身体才能——跳得高、跑得快；莉莉有数字才能——算得快；杰克有音乐才能——唱歌、弹钢琴。你有哪种才能？多尝试就能发现。认识自己的才能，是成长第一步！我们在班里做才能板，把名字写在对应类型下。画得好的孩子把星贴在绘画才能下。我们互相访谈，分享一个小长处。没有哪种才能更高贵，只是不同。认识自己擅长什么，帮我们选真正喜欢的爱好并成长。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（I've got... talent: picture/word/body/number/musical）

title: My Family's Talents
passage: Last week we made a Family Talents Board. I asked, "What is your dad good at?" Mum said, "Your dad is good at fixing things. He has body talent." Dad asked me, "Can you teach me to draw?" I have picture talent, so I taught him a simple cat. My little sister has musical talent; she sings every day. We wrote each person's talent on the board. Family talent is love plus support plus growth. It was fun to learn about each other. On the board, we also write how we can help each other. Dad fixes a broken chair and teaches me to use a small tool. Mum sings me a song when I cannot sleep. My sister teaches me a few dance steps. We take a photo of the board and stick it on the fridge. A family that shares talents grows closer and supports every member's dream.
passageZh: 上周我们做了一块“家庭才能板”。我问：“爸爸擅长什么？”妈妈说：“你爸爸擅长修理东西，他有身体才能。”爸爸问我：“你能教我画画吗？”我有绘画才能，就教他画了一只简单的猫。小妹妹有音乐才能，每天唱歌。我们把每个人的才能写在板上。家庭才能是爱、支持加成长。了解彼此很有趣。板上我们还写下如何互相帮助。爸爸修好坏椅子，教我用小工具。妈妈在我睡不着时唱歌。姐姐教我几个舞步。我们给板拍照，贴在冰箱上。分享才能的家庭更亲密，支持每位成员的梦想。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（What is your dad good at? Can you teach me?）

title: A Little Bird Finds Its Talent
passage: Little Chick wanted to join the talent show. "What are you good at?" asked the teacher. "I don't know," said Chick. He saw Duck dancing and Bird singing. He cried, "I am not good at anything." Mouse came and said, "Don't cry. What do you like doing?" "I like running," said Chick. "Then practise running!" Chick ran every day. In the show, he ran the fastest and won first prize. "I've got body talent!" said Chick. Courage and practice turn a try into talent. After winning, Chick did not stop running. He still practises every morning and joins other races. Mouse explains that everyone first feels unsure, but trying reveals a hidden strength. Duck and Bird cheer for their friend even though their talents differ. The show teaches the whole forest: courage to try matters more than being perfect at once.
passageZh: 小鸡想参加才艺表演。“你擅长什么？”老师问。“我不知道，”小鸡说。他看到鸭子跳舞、小鸟唱歌，哭着说：“我什么都不擅长。”老鼠走过来说：“别哭，你喜欢做什么？”“我喜欢跑步，”小鸡说。“那就练习跑步！”小鸡每天跑。表演上他跑得最快，得了一等奖。“我有身体才能！”小鸡说。勇气加练习，让尝试变成才能。获奖后，小鸡没有停止跑步。他仍每天早上练习，参加其他比赛。老鼠解释说，每个人起初都会不确定，但尝试会揭示隐藏的长处。鸭子和鸟虽然才能不同，仍为朋友加油。表演教会整个森林：敢于尝试比一开始就完美更重要。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U3原创（才艺发现 + 坚持练习）

title: Parts of a Plant
passage: Look at a green plant. What's this? It's a root. The root grows under the ground and holds the plant. It takes water from the soil. This is a stem. The stem is long and thin, and it carries water up to the top. These are leaves. The leaves are big and green and make food for the plant. This is a flower. It looks beautiful and smells nice. Inside the flower, there is a seed. A new plant can grow from that seed. On a spring morning, our teacher brings a small potted plant to class. We pass it around and touch the soft leaf carefully. We draw the plant in our notebook and label each part. The root hides under the soil, so we cannot see it, yet it keeps the plant steady. Knowing the parts of a plant helps us understand how it drinks, grows and finally blooms.
passageZh: 看一棵绿色植物。这是什么？这是根，根长在地下固定植物，从土壤吸水。这是茎，又长又细，把水送到顶部。这些是叶子，又大又绿，为植物制造养分。这是花，美丽又香。花里面有一粒种子，新植物能从种子长出来。春天的一个早上，老师带一盆小植物到教室。我们轮流传递，轻轻摸叶子。我们在笔记本上画下植物，给每个部分标注名称。根藏在土里看不见，却让植物站稳。认识植物各部分，帮我们理解它怎样喝水、生长、最终开花。

title: We Are Planting Seeds
passage: Today our class is in the school garden. We're planting seeds in the soft soil. Look! She's watering the flowers gently. They're digging a small hole with their hands. I'm putting a seed into the earth and covering it. —What are you doing? —I'm watering my pot. Seeds need water and sun every day. We will check our plants tomorrow. We feel excited because we are growing something. We work in small groups so nobody is left alone. One child digs, another waters, and another writes the date on a stick label. We keep the pot on the windowsill where it receives soft sun. Each day we count the new leaves and write a short note. Growing together in the garden teaches us patience and care, and we wait happily for the first green shoot.

title: My Seed Grows
passage: On Day 1, I planted a seed in a pot. I watered it every morning and put it in the sun. For many days, I saw no change, and I felt worried. But I kept taking care of it. On Day 10, a small green shoot came up! I was very happy. Now the plant is growing. Its leaves are green, and it stands straight. Yesterday I added a little water. Plants need care, just like us. I feel proud of my little plant. After the shoot came up, I turned the pot a little every week so every side received light. I never poured too much water, because wet soil can rot the seed. My grandfather taught me to watch the plant rather than hurry it. Now the stem is straight and the leaves shine in the sun. A plant grows in its own time, just like we grow day by day.
passageZh: 第一天，我在花盆种下一粒种子。每天早上浇水、放在阳光下。很多天没变化，我有点担心，但继续照顾它。第10天，一棵小绿芽冒出来！我非常开心。现在植物正在生长，叶子翠绿、笔直挺立。昨天我又浇了点水。植物像我们一样需要照顾，我为我的小植物自豪。芽长出后，我每周把花盆转一点，让每面都见光。我从不浇太多水，因为湿土会让种子腐烂。爷爷教我观察植物而不是催促它。现在茎笔直，叶子在阳光下发亮。植物按自己的时间生长，就像我们一天天长大。

title: Plants Are Used to Make Things
passage: Plants are very useful in our daily life. Plants are used to make paper; this page comes from wood. A cotton shirt is made from the cotton plant. A wooden chair comes from a tree. A bamboo basket is made of bamboo. We get food, clothes and medicine from plants. But plastic does not come from plants. We should protect plants because they give us so much. Reducing paper also helps save trees. Paper comes from trees, so using both sides of a sheet saves wood. Cotton grows in warm fields, and farmers pick it by hand or machine. Wood is dried before it becomes a chair or table. Bamboo grows fast and returns quickly after cutting. When we choose plant-based things, we should also use them carefully and never waste, so forests stay green for children in the future.
passageZh: 植物在日常生活中非常有用。纸是用植物做的，这页纸来自木材；棉衬衫来自棉花；木椅子来自树木；竹筐由竹子编成。我们从植物获得食物、衣服和药。但塑料不来自植物。我们应该保护植物，因为它们给予我们很多。节约用纸也能帮助保护树木。纸来自树木，所以双面用纸节省木材。棉花长在温暖田里，农民用手或机器采摘。木材干燥后才做成桌椅。竹子长得快，砍后很快再生。选择植物制品时，我们也应爱惜、不浪费，让森林为未来的孩子保持绿色。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4原创（Plants are used to make...）

title: Grandpa the Rice Scientist
passage: My grandpa is a scientist. He works in the fields and studies rice. He has a dream: to grow tall rice plants with big grains. When he was young, he worked hard every day in the sun. He watched the plants, watered them, and wrote down his findings. Now his rice grows strong. People around the country enjoy the rice. Plants feed the world. Grandpa teaches me patience: with water, sun and time, we can grow tall and strong, just like a good plant. Grandpa gets up before sunrise and walks through the fields. He writes the height of each rice plant in a small notebook. He talks to the plants as if they were old friends. His dream feeds many people, and it teaches me that hard work starts small. When I grow up, I want to study nature too and help feed the world, just like Grandpa.
passageZh: 我爷爷是科学家，在田里研究水稻。他有个梦想：种出高个子、谷粒饱满的水稻。年轻时他每天在阳光下辛勤工作，观察、浇水、记录发现。现在他的水稻长得强壮，全国人民都吃到这种米。植物养活世界。爷爷教会我耐心：有水、阳光和时间，我们就能像好植物一样长得又高又壮。爷爷日出前起床，走过田埂。他在小本子记下每株水稻的高度。他像对老朋友一样对植物说话。他的梦想养活许多人，也教会我：努力从细小处开始。长大后，我也想研究自然、像爷爷一样帮助养活世界。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U4原创（科学家梦想 + 植物生长寓意）

title: Our School Events
passage: Our school has many interesting events every term. There is an art festival in spring. There are games at the school picnic. There is a sports meeting on the playground. There are trees in the tree-planting day. There is a talent show on the stage. There are many books in the reading corner. Last month we joined the art festival. This week we went on a field trip. Each event gives us fun and new friends. At the art festival, we hang our drawings along the corridor. At the picnic, parents bring dishes to share under the trees. The sports meeting fills the playground with running and cheering. The talent show lets every child show one small strength. The reading corner always has new books to borrow. School events join learning and fun, and they make the year feel lively and full.
passageZh: 我们学校每学期有很多有趣活动。春天有艺术节，学校野餐有游戏，操场上有运动会，植树日有很多树，舞台上有才艺表演，阅读角有很多书。上个月我们参加艺术节，这周去了实地考察。每个活动都给我们快乐和新朋友。艺术节我们把画沿走廊挂起。野餐时家长带菜到树下分享。运动会让操场满是奔跑和欢呼。才艺表演让每个孩子展示一个小长处。阅读角总有新书可借。学校活动把学习和乐趣结合，让这一年生动充实。

title: On the Field Trip
passage: Today our class goes on a field trip to the forest. We look around and ask questions. —Is there a bird in the tree? —Yes, there is. —Are there any flowers on the ground? —Yes, there are. —Is there a small plant under the stone? —No, there isn't. —Are there any insects on the leaf? —No, there aren't. Our teacher helps us read nature. We walk quietly and watch carefully. The forest is full of surprises. Our teacher gives each group a small notebook to draw what we see. We compare notes about the birds and flowers we find. The forest keeper warns us not to touch unknown insects or pick rare plants. Walking quietly lets real animals come near without fear. Field trips teach us to observe nature with respect, and every small discovery feels exciting.
passageZh: 今天全班去森林实地考察。我们四处观察提问。——树上有鸟吗？——是的，有。——地上有花吗？——是的，有。——石头下面有小植物吗？——不，没有。——叶子上有昆虫吗？——不，没有。老师帮我们读懂自然。我们安静走路、仔细观察，森林充满惊喜。老师给每组一个小本子，画下所见。我们比较记录找到的鸟和花。森林管理员提醒我们不碰不明昆虫、不摘稀有植物。安静走路，让真正的动物不惧靠近。实地考察教我们尊重自然地观察，每个小发现都令人兴奋。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5原创（Is there...? / Are there...? 及答语）

title: The Baby Bird's Homecoming
passage: On the field trip, Lanlan and Weiwei find a baby bird on the ground. It fell off the tree. There is no nest under it. They do not touch it, because its mother may be near. They call the teacher, and the forest keeper comes quickly. Is there a mother bird nearby? Yes, she is waiting in the branches. The keeper climbs the tree and puts the baby bird back into the nest. The mother bird comes back. We felt happy to help a little bird. Before calling the keeper, the children backed away slowly so the baby bird was not frightened. The mother bird watched from a branch and did not attack anyone. After the rescue, our teacher explained that baby birds learn to fly from low branches. We wrote a short report about the day. Helping one small creature teaches us kindness, and it becomes our favourite memory of the trip.
passageZh: 实地考察时，兰兰和伟伟在地上发现一只雏鸟，它从树上掉下，下面没有巢。他们没有碰它，因为鸟妈妈可能就在附近。他们叫来老师，森林管理员很快赶来。附近有鸟妈妈吗？是的，她在枝头等着。管理员爬上树把雏鸟放回巢里，鸟妈妈回来了。帮助一只小鸟让我们很开心。叫管理员前，孩子们慢慢后退，以免吓到雏鸟。鸟妈妈在枝头看着，没有攻击任何人。救援后，老师解释雏鸟从低枝学飞。我们写了一篇关于这一天的短报告。帮助一个小生命教会我们善良，它成为这次旅行最美好的回忆。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5原创（The Baby Bird's Homecoming 故事 + there be）

title: My Favourite School Event
passage: My favourite school event is the school picnic. There is a big tent on the grass. There are balloons in the sky. There is a table full of food, like sandwiches and fruit. Are there any games? Yes, there are. We play games and share food with classmates. I have fun because my friends are with me. Last year we sat under a big tree and laughed. Events like this make school warm and joyful. At the picnic, we spread a big cloth and pass dishes around. The balloons dance in the light wind, and music plays softly in the background. We play simple games like guessing riddles and passing a ball. My grandmother came along and told stories about her school picnic years ago. The best events are not the expensive ones, but the ones shared with people we love.
passageZh: 我最喜欢的学校活动是学校野餐。草地上有一顶大帐篷，天上有气球，桌上摆满三明治、水果等食物。有游戏吗？有的。我们玩游戏、和同学分享食物。因为朋友在身边，我玩得很开心。去年我们坐在大树下欢笑。这样的活动让学校温暖又快乐。野餐时我们铺开大布，传菜分享。气球在微风中摇摆，音乐轻轻播放。我们玩猜谜、传球等简单游戏。奶奶也来了，讲她多年前学校野餐的故事。最好的活动不是昂贵的，而是和爱的人一起分享的。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U5原创（My favourite event; There is/are; because）

title: Last Term's Events
passage: Last term our school had many events. In October, we had an art festival. We drew pictures and sang English songs. I wrote Chinese words on a big red paper, and my teacher said they looked nice. In November, we went on a field trip to Green Forest. We saw tall trees and lovely birds. We did not touch the baby bird we found. In December, we held a small talent show. We learned a lot and made new friends. School events make every term colourful. After the art festival, our class put the best drawings in a folder. On the field trip, we collected dry leaves to press in books. The talent show had only a few children on stage, but every classmate clapped loudly. We write down each event in our school diary and read it at the end of term. Looking back, every event taught us something new and brought us closer as a class.

title: What Are You Wearing?
passage: Today is the school fashion day. —What are you wearing today, Daming? —I'm wearing a T-shirt and shorts. It's hot today. Lingling is wearing her favourite blue dress. Amy is wearing a pink skirt and a white shirt. Sam is wearing a yellow jacket and grey trousers. We wear different clothes for different weather. On cold days, we wear a sweater, a jacket and a scarf. Clothes keep us comfortable and warm. We choose clothes according to the weather and the activity. On hot days, light cotton keeps us cool; on cold days, layers trap warm air. We check the forecast in the morning before choosing what to wear. A hat protects the face from sun, and gloves keep hands warm in winter. Clothes are not only pretty; they protect our body and make us feel comfortable all day.
passageZh: 今天是学校时装日。——大明，你今天穿什么？——我穿T恤和短裤，今天很热。玲玲穿着她最喜欢的蓝连衣裙，埃米穿粉裙子和白衬衫，萨姆穿黄夹克和灰裤子。不同天气穿不同衣服。冷天我们穿毛衣、夹克、围巾。衣服让我们舒适保暖。我们根据天气和活动选衣服。热天轻薄棉料凉快，冷天多层衣物锁住暖空气。早上选衣服前先看天气预报。帽子防晒，手套冬天保暖。衣服不只好看，还保护身体，让我们全天舒适。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6原创（What are you wearing? I'm wearing...; 衣物词汇）

title: At the Clothes Shop
passage: Mum and I are in a clothes shop. —What do you want? —I'd like a red skirt, please. —What size? —Size M, please. The shop assistant shows me a blue sweater, too. It's warm and soft. Dad would like a new pair of shoes; he needs them for walking. Mum would like a cotton scarf. We talk about colour, size and material before we buy. Shopping for clothes is fun when we know what we want. The shop assistant folds each piece neatly and shows us the mirror. We check the size by trying on a small, a medium and a large. Colour matters too: red looks bright, while blue feels calm. My mother always asks about the material before paying. Shopping becomes easy when we know what we want, what size fits and what material suits the season.
passageZh: 我和妈妈在服装店。——你想要什么？——我想要一条红裙子。——什么尺码？——M码。店员还给我看一件蓝毛衣，又暖又软。爸爸想要一双新鞋，走路需要；妈妈想要一条棉围巾。买之前我们讨论颜色、尺码和材质。知道自己想要什么，买衣服很有趣。店员把每件衣服叠整齐，带我们照镜子。我们试小、中、大码看合身。颜色也重要：红色鲜亮，蓝色安静。妈妈付款前总问材质。知道想要什么、什么码合身、什么材质适合季节，购物就变得轻松。

title: Made of Old Things
passage: We can make cool clothes from old things. My dress is made of an old black bag. My vest is made of old plastic bags. My hat is made of old paper. My bag is made of an old T-shirt. What is it made of? It's cool because we reuse old things and help the Earth. We follow Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. Old cloth does not need to become rubbish. With a little creativity, we can turn it into something new. Before making something, we wash and dry the old material carefully. Scissors, glue and a needle are kept away from small children. We draw a simple shape on the old cloth first, then cut it slowly. Old T-shirts become bags, and old socks become soft toys. Reusing things saves money and reduces rubbish, and it teaches children to be creative and kind to the Earth.
passageZh: 我们可以用旧东西做很酷的衣服。我的连衣裙用旧黑包做成，背心用旧塑料袋，帽子用旧纸，包用旧T恤。它是用什么做的？它很酷，因为我们重复利用旧物、保护地球。我们遵循“减少、重复利用、回收”。旧布不必变成垃圾，一点创意就能把它变成新东西。做东西前，我们先把旧材料洗净晾干。剪刀、胶水、针放在小孩够不到的地方。先在旧布上画简单形状，再慢慢剪。旧T恤变成包，旧袜子变成软玩具。重复利用省钱、减少垃圾，也教会孩子有创意、对地球友善。
source: 外研版（2024/2025新教材·三年级起点）；四下教案U6原创（Made of... / Why? Because... / 3R环保）

title: Uniforms Help Us
passage: Many people wear uniforms. A policeman wears a dark uniform and helps keep us safe. A doctor wears a white coat in the hospital. A firefighter wears a special suit to fight fire. A pilot wears a uniform in the cockpit. Uniforms tell us what job a person does, and they also protect the worker. —What is he wearing? —He is wearing a police uniform. We can recognise a helper at once by the uniform. Different uniforms have special colours and marks that we can recognise from far away. A doctor's white coat keeps clothes clean, and a firefighter's suit resists heat. A pilot's uniform looks neat inside the cockpit. When we see a uniform, we know who can help us in trouble. Uniforms are practical, and they also show pride in the job a person does.
passageZh: 很多人穿制服。警察穿深色制服，帮助保护我们安全；医生在医院穿白大褂；消防员穿特制服装灭火；飞行员在驾驶舱穿制服。制服告诉我们对方的职业，也保护劳动者。——他穿着什么？——他穿着警服。我们一看制服就能认出一位帮忙的人。不同制服有特殊颜色和标志，我们远远就能认出。医生白大褂保持衣服干净，消防员服装耐热。飞行员制服在驾驶舱里整齐。看到制服，我们知道遇到麻烦时谁能帮忙。制服实用，也体现对所做工作的自豪。

title: Our Green Fashion Show
passage: Last Friday, our class held a green fashion show. We used old materials. I wore a hat made of old paper and a vest made of old plastic bags. My friend walked out in a dress made of an old bag. We walked on the small stage and smiled. —What are you wearing? —I'm wearing a hat, a shirt and a skirt! It's made of old plastic bags! The teachers clapped and said our ideas were creative. They want to make one too. Green fashion is fun and kind to the Earth. Before the show, we spent two afternoons cutting and gluing old materials. Each model walked slowly on the small stage and introduced the outfit. The audience asked, "What is it made of?" and we answered with pride. Some teachers even joined in and made a hat from old paper. Green fashion proves that beauty and care for the Earth can go together, and everyone went home inspired.
passageZh: 上周五我们班办了绿色时装秀，用旧材料。我戴旧纸帽、穿旧塑料袋背心；朋友穿旧包做的连衣裙走出。我们在小舞台上走，微笑。——你穿什么？——我戴着帽子、穿着衬衫和裙子！它用旧塑料袋做成！老师鼓掌，说我们的想法很有创意，他们也想做一件。绿色时装有趣又对地球友好。表演前，我们用两个下午裁剪、粘贴旧材料。每个模特在小舞台慢慢走，介绍服装。观众问“它用什么做的？”我们自豪回答。有些老师也参加，用旧纸做了帽子。绿色时装证明美和爱护地球可以并存，大家回家时都受到启发。

title: A snack survey at school
passage:
What snacks do you like? Chocolate, chips, biscuits, candies or fruit? We asked fifty primary school students. Seventeen students love chips. Thirteen students like biscuits, twelve love chocolate and eight like candies. The snacks high in fat, salt and sugar are their favourites.
Too many of these snacks are not good for us. One bar of chocolate has about ten teaspoons of sugar. A bag of chips every day is like drinking five bottles of oil a year! So, next time you have a snack, make healthy choices.
The survey covered fifty students from two Grade Five classes. It showed that salty and sugary snacks were the most popular, while fruit and plain vegetables were chosen by only a few children. The health teacher used the results to give a talk at assembly. She explained that too much sugar can make teeth hurt and too much oil can make the body heavy. After the talk, many students started choosing an apple or a handful of nuts instead of a bag of chips. Small daily choices, the teacher said, add up to a healthy body over the years.

你喜欢什么零食？巧克力、炸薯条、饼干、糖果还是水果？我们问了五十名小学生。十七名学生喜欢炸薯条，十三名喜欢饼干，十二名喜欢巧克力，八名喜欢糖果。那些高脂肪、高盐、高糖的零食是他们的最爱。
吃太多这类零食对我们不好。一块巧克力大约含有十茶匙糖。每天吃一袋炸薯条，一年下来就像喝了五瓶油！所以下次吃零食时，要做出健康的选择。
调查覆盖了两个五年级班的五十名学生。结果显示咸甜零食最受欢迎，水果和清炒蔬菜只有少数孩子选择。保健老师用结果在集会上做了讲座。她解释糖太多会伤牙，油太多会让身体变沉。讲座后许多学生开始选苹果或一小把坚果，而不是一袋炸薯条。老师说，每天的小选择日积月累就成就健康的身体。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上听力脚本U1（Activity 3  snack survey）

title: A letter from your stomach
passage:
Dear Sally,
That's enough! This is a bad day for me again!
Every morning, you need a good breakfast. Let's have bread, milk, eggs, fruit and vegetables. Just a few biscuits are not enough! I often feel hungry all morning.
Then you often eat too much for lunch. You have a lot of meat, but no vegetables and no fruit. I get too heavy. This makes you sleepy in the afternoon.
And you always eat dinner too fast so you can go and play. You should eat slowly. I have to work hard for a long time after dinner. I'm so tired.
Sally, please make some changes. Help me stay healthy. Then you are healthy, too.
With love,
Your stomach
passageZh:
亲爱的萨莉：够了！对我来说今天又是糟糕的一天！
每天早上你需要一顿丰盛的早餐。吃面包、牛奶、鸡蛋、水果和蔬菜吧。只吃几块饼干是不够的，整个上午我都常常觉得饿。
然后午饭你又吃太多，吃很多肉，却没有蔬菜和水果。我变得太沉，这让你下午犯困。
你晚饭总是吃得太快好去玩耍，应该慢慢吃。晚饭后我得辛苦工作很久，我太累了。
萨莉，请做出改变，帮我保持健康，这样你自己也会健康。爱你的，你的胃。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U1

title: My healthy eating day

My name is Amy. I want to tell you about my eating habits.
For breakfast, I often have milk, bread and an egg. Mum says breakfast is very important. At school, I have lunch with my friends. I eat noodles or rice, and some meat or fish. I also eat vegetables like tomatoes and potatoes.
Before, I only ate fast food like hamburgers. But fast food has too much oil and salt. Now I know we should not take too much sugar. I drink water every day, not cola.
After dinner, I eat an apple or a banana. Healthy food makes me feel well and study better. I hope you can eat well too!

title: Go, slow, whoa! Know your food groups
passage:
Want to eat right? Remember three words: Go, slow, whoa!
Go foods help us grow and give us energy. Tomatoes, grapes and oats are Go foods. They are full of vitamins and fibre, so we can eat them often.
Slow foods are nice but we should not take too much. Biscuits, juice and nuts are Slow foods. They have some sugar or fat, so be slow and enjoy just a little.
Whoa foods make our body slow. Chips, candies and cakes are Whoa foods. They have a lot of fat, salt or sugar, so we should say no.
Next time you choose a snack, ask yourself: Go, slow, or whoa?
passageZh:
想吃得健康吗？记住三个词：畅吃、慢吃、停住！
“畅吃”食物帮我们长大、给我们能量。西红柿、葡萄、燕麦属于畅吃类，富含维生素和纤维，可以常吃。
“慢吃”食物不错，但别吃太多。饼干、果汁、坚果属于慢吃类，含有一些糖或脂肪，要慢一点、只吃一点。
“停住”食物让身体变迟缓。炸薯条、糖果、蛋糕属于停住类，脂肪、盐或糖很多，我们应该说不。
下次选零食时，问问自己：畅吃、慢吃，还是停住？
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Fuel up U1+知识清单

title: A healthy lunch at the school canteen
passage:
Today is Monday. The school canteen has a new menu. There is rice, fish, beef, salad, soup, fruit and some bread.
Daming looks at the menu. He wants chicken and beef, but there are no vegetables on his plate. The teacher says, "Don't take too much meat! You should have some vegetables." Daming looks again and adds some tomatoes and potatoes.
Amy chooses fish, rice and a bowl of vegetable soup. She takes an apple after lunch too.
After lunch, the children feel full but not heavy. They learn that a balanced diet keeps them healthy. They decide to make good choices every day.

title: Milk box magic
passage:
Dear all,
Each of us has a box of milk every day at school. We use over 150,000 milk boxes every year! But many of us just throw them away.
Milk boxes have three parts: paper, plastic and metal. Each part can turn into something new, like newspapers, bottles and cans.
It is easy to recycle a milk box in just three steps:
1. Open the milk box and wash it with water.
2. Make it flat.
3. Put it into a recycling box.
Now the milk box moves to a new beginning! Let's start now for a green world!
Students from Class 502

passage:

title: The three Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle
passage:
We can follow the three Rs to live a green life.
First, reduce. Don't buy too many things we don't need, and don't take too much food on our plate. Saving energy at home is also a good way: turn off the lights when we leave a room.
Second, reuse. Use both sides of the paper. We can give old books and clothes to others instead of throwing them away. Old T-shirts can become shopping bags.
Third, recycle. Sort the rubbish into different bins. Paper, glass, metal and plastic can be recycled and turn into new things.
Earth Day comes on 22 April every year, but we can be green every day. Small actions add up.
passageZh: 我们可以遵循3R原则过绿色生活。第一，减少：不买太多不需要的东西，盘子里别拿太多食物；离开房间关灯也是节能。第二，重复利用：纸两面都用，旧书旧衣服送人而不是扔掉，旧T恤可改成购物袋。第三，回收：垃圾分类投放，纸、玻璃、金属、塑料可回收变新物。地球日在每年4月22日，但我们可以天天环保，小行动累积起来。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上知识清单U2（3R/Earth Day）原创

title: Cutting down plastic at school

title: Duoduo's best friends
passage:
For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend. He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys. This makes Duoduo unhappy.
Tutu asks Duoduo to join them, but Duoduo just walks away.
After a week, Duoduo feels sad and misses Tutu. "But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends," he thinks.
Just then, Tutu sits down next to him. "Hi Duoduo. How are you?" Tutu asks.
"I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now," answers Duoduo.
"Why do you say that?" says Tutu. "Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend. Old friends and new friends are both very nice. Join us and they can be your friends, too."
Now Duoduo has three best friends!

title: Friends with differences
passage:
Mum: Bird, you can't be friends with Dog because you're so different.
Dad: Dog, you can't be friends with Bird because you're so different.
Bird: Let's show them we aren't different. Then we can be friends.

Rabbit: Hey, why are you looking worried?

title: Say sorry and talk it out
passage:
Mum: Sally, what's wrong? You look worried.
Sally: It's Mia. We have to work together on our science homework. I want to study sea animals, but Mia wants to study plastic. We can't change each other's ideas, so we get angry.
Mum: Are you still angry?
Sally: No. But what should I do?
Mum: First, go and say sorry to Mia. Friends should be nice to each other.
Sally: OK. Then what?
Mum: Next, have a talk with Mia. Friends should listen to each other. You can find the right plan for the homework.
Sally: Thank you, Mum.
Mum: I'm sure you can be good friends again very soon.

title: What makes a good friend?
passage:
What is a friend? A friend is someone who shares your happiness and stands by you when you are sad.
Tutu and I live in the same street. Every morning we walk to school together. At school, we help each other with homework. When I am sad, Tutu often tells me jokes and makes me laugh.
We have different hobbies. Tutu likes sports, and I like reading. But we still enjoy talking to each other after class. Sometimes friends argue, but that is OK. We should say sorry when we are wrong.
Every year, 30 July is the United Nations International Day of Friendship. On that day, people say thank you to their friends. Good friends make our life warm and colourful.

source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上知识清单U3（友谊日）原创

title: Three friends, three hobbies
passage:
I have three best friends: Tutu, Xiaojun and Momo. Tutu and I live in the same street. We play games together and we always have fun.
Xiaojun and I have different hobbies, but we enjoy talking to each other. He loves science, and I love stories. Momo often makes me laugh because he is funny. He is very musical, and we often sing together. He is very cool.
We help each other when someone is in trouble. We listen when someone feels sad, and we share our snacks at break time.
I love my friends. We are happy together, and I hope our friendship lasts forever.

passage:

title: The boy who carved a word on the desk
passage:
My mornings are always busy. My father is ill, but my family has little money. So before school, I have to sell things. With the money, I go to buy medicine for my father. It's a long way, and sometimes there are a lot of people.
This morning, there are too many people. I'm worried. I hurry to school, but I'm still late. I run into the classroom and my teacher is there. He is unhappy with me. "Don't be late again," he says. I feel sad. I sit at my desk and cut a word into it. I'm not going to be late again.
passageZh: 我的早晨总是忙碌。父亲病了，家里没什么钱，所以上学前我得先卖东西，用换来的钱给父亲买药。路很远，有时人很多。今天早上人太多，我着急，匆匆赶到学校还是迟到了。跑进教室，老师就在那儿，他很不满：“别再迟到了。”我很难过，坐到座位上，在桌上刻了一个字——我再也不迟到了。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U4（Story time）

title: Julia Hawkins: try new things
passage:
Dad: I'm going to go swimming. Do you want to come, Billy?
Billy: No, thanks, Dad. I'm afraid of water. I don't think I can do it well.
Dad: Oh dear. You should have a try. Let me tell you about Julia Hawkins. She starts running after her 100th birthday and sets the world record for her age group in the 100-metre run.
Billy: Wow, she's amazing!
Dad: At 105, she runs the 100 metres in 1 minute and 2.95 seconds.
Billy: She's so cool! I should try new things, like her.
Dad: Great! Just start today.
Billy: OK, I'm in. Let's go!

title: Our New Year plans
passage:
A new year is a good time to make plans. Our class talks about what we are going to try.
Amy is going to read more books. She wants to read twenty books this year. Sam is going to exercise more and run every morning. Lingling is going to learn to play the piano. At first she plays badly and wants to stop, but her mother says, "It's OK to fail. Don't give up."
Daming wants to try something new. He joins the basketball club and keeps practising.
Making a plan is easy, but keeping it is hard. If we try our best and never give up, we grow better day by day.

title: It's OK to fail
passage:
Everyone wants to be good at something, but nobody is good at it at first. When I started to ride a bike, I fell down many times. I wanted to stop. My father told me, "You may fail, but that's okay. Just start again."
I kept practising every weekend. Slowly, I could balance and then ride around the park. I felt so proud.
Now I understand: trying new things is never a waste. Failure is just a step on the way to success. Don't be afraid. Just start today, and keep going.
passageZh: 人人都想擅长某事，但起初没人天生就会。我学骑车时摔了很多次，想放弃。爸爸说：“你可能失败，但没关系，重新开始就好。”我每个周末坚持练习，慢慢能保持平衡，然后能绕着公园骑，我特别自豪。现在我明白：尝试新事物从不白费，失败只是通往成功的一步。别害怕，今天就开始，坚持下去。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上Fuel up chant U4+知识清单原创

title: Cities of the future
passage:
This city will be under the sea. People will live in glass balls. Sea animals will be all around the houses. There will be special farms under the sea. A special glass box will take people up to the land. It will go very fast! Life under the sea will be clean, beautiful and interesting!
This city will be on the moon. It will be a very different place. Plants there will grow very big. People will make houses under them. They won't need to worry about food. People will put on special shoes to fly around. They will celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival right on the moon!

title: Food in the future
passage:
Prof Green: Today we are going to talk about food in the future. Scientists are always trying new ways to make food. I will share two of them.
One is using 3-D printing to make food. People will make biscuits, chocolate, pizza and bread with it. It can make the food into any shape.
The other way is making a pill. Some people think we won't need to eat food in the future. The pill can give people all the things the body needs. In this way, they will have more free time for other activities. Do you want to have a try?

title: Robots in our future life
passage:
In the future, robots will be part of our daily life. They will work in factories, hospitals and farms. Some robots will cook, clean and look after old people. Others will help students in the classroom, but students will still read and write by themselves.
People will travel by flying cars, and the cars will take us anywhere in minutes. We will use 3-D printing to make food, clothes and even houses.
Machines will not do everything. Students will still study hard, because thinking and learning are important. The future will be wonderful if we care about nature.

title: Life on the moon
passage:
What will life be like on the moon? Some scientists say people will live in comfortable rooms under glass. Plants will grow inside, and people will grow fresh food there.
Children won't carry heavy bags. They will read on small computers at home or at school. Robots will help with heavy work, and people will have more time for hobbies and friends.
People will put on special shoes to fly from place to place. On weekends, families will look at the Earth in the sky and tell stories.
Living on the moon sounds amazing, but we must study science hard to build that future ourselves.

title: A special Mid-Autumn Festival at the zoo
passage:
Daming: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Let's make mooncakes for the animals at the zoo!
Zookeeper: Hello, children! What mooncakes are you going to make?
Sam: I'm going to make meat mooncakes for the tigers.
Lingling: I'm going to make bamboo mooncakes for the pandas.
Amy: I'm going to make mooncakes for the giraffes. I'll use leaves and carrots.
Daming: I want to make banana mooncakes for the elephants.
Sam: They will be very big!
Zookeeper: Thank you, children! It's a happy Mid-Autumn Festival for the animals! And Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to you, too!

source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Start up U6

title: Barbapapa's Christmas tree
passage:
Christmas is coming! But Dad, we haven't got a Christmas tree. I'll go to the forest and get us a tree.
Please don't cut down this tree. It's our home.
This one is good. This one is good, too. Please don't. Why? You don't live in a tree. But I live in the forest. Animals here need these trees.
I see. You're right. The children are waiting at home. Oh! I have an idea!
Merry Christmas, everyone! Dad, the Christmas tree is great! No one will have a tree like this. We love it, Dad!
passageZh: 圣诞节快到了，可我们还没有圣诞树。我去森林弄一棵。请别砍这棵树，它是我们的家。这棵不错，那棵也不错，请不要砍。为什么？你又不住树上。可我住森林里，动物需要这些树。我明白了，你说得对。孩子们在家等。哦！我有个主意！大家圣诞快乐！爸爸，这棵圣诞树真棒，没人有这样的树，我们爱它！
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上教材PDF Speed up U6（Story time）

title: New Year around the world
passage:
Interviewer: New Year's Eve is coming. How are children around the world celebrating it?
Xiaoman (China): I'm going to Xi'an with my parents. We're going to listen to the New Year's bell under the Bell Tower.
Charlie (UK): I'm going to my friend's house. We'll have a party. At 12 am, we will share warm wishes with each other.
Maria (Spain): I'm going to have dinner with my family. We will eat 12 grapes at 12 am. We think it brings luck in the new year.
Daniel (Australia): I'm going to the Sydney Harbour Bridge to watch the fireworks.

title: Chinese traditional festivals
passage:
China has many traditional festivals. The Spring Festival is the most important. Before it, people clean their houses and buy delicious food. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner, eat dumplings and watch the New Year show. Children wear new clothes and get red packets.
The Mid-Autumn Festival comes in autumn. On that night, the moon is big and round. People sit together, eat mooncakes and watch the full moon.
The Dragon Boat Festival remembers the great poet Qu Yuan. People eat rice dumplings and watch dragon boat races.
At every festival, families get together. Festivals tell us about our culture and history.
passageZh: 中国有许多传统节日。春节最重要，节前人们打扫房子、买美食，除夕夜全家聚餐、吃饺子、看新年演出，孩子穿新衣、收红包。中秋节在秋天，那晚月亮又大又圆，人们聚在一起吃月饼、赏月。端午节纪念伟大诗人屈原，人们吃粽子、看赛龙舟。每个节日家人团聚，节日向我们讲述文化与历史。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五上知识清单U6（节日习俗）原创

title: Making lanterns for the show
passage:
The lantern show for the Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Lingling and her friends decide to make lanterns.
Lingling is going to make a rabbit lantern. Sam is going to make a dog lantern. Amy is going to make flower and fish lanterns. Daming wants to make an orange lantern with a small candle in it.
They collect paper, sticks and colours. They cut, fold and glue carefully. At last, each lantern looks beautiful.
"Let's get started. It will be fun," says Sam. The children are sure their lanterns will shine brightly at the show.

title: A frog's life cycle
passage:
A frog's life cycle is a story of growing up too. First, it is an egg in the water. Then it becomes a tadpole with a long tail. It can't walk, but it can swim. Next, the tadpole grows legs. Its tail becomes shorter. Then it becomes a young frog. It can jump and live on land. At last, it is a big frog. It can catch insects for food. Growing up helps the frog live in different places.
A frog lays many eggs in the pond in spring. Each egg hatches into a tadpole that breathes with gills and swims with a long tail. Slowly the tadpole grows back legs and then front legs, while its tail slowly shrinks. When the gills disappear and lungs grow, the young frog climbs onto land. The whole cycle usually takes about two or three months. Watching this change teaches children that every living thing grows step by step, just like we do ourselves.
passageZh:
青蛙的生命周期也是一个成长故事。起初它是水里的一颗卵，然后变成长尾巴的蝌蚪，不会走但会游。接着蝌蚪长出腿，尾巴变短，变成幼蛙，会跳、能在陆地生活。最后变成大青蛙，能捕捉昆虫为食。成长帮助青蛙生活在不同地方。
春天青蛙在池塘里产下许多卵。每颗卵孵化成蝌蚪，用鳃呼吸、用长尾游泳。蝌蚪慢慢长出后腿再长前腿，尾巴逐渐缩短。鳃消失、肺长出后，幼蛙爬上陆地。整个周期通常需要两三个月。观察这一变化教会孩子：每个生命都像我们自己一样一步步成长。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U1测试卷笔试（提高卷·阅读选择）

title: Tom's growing-up moment
passage:
Last year, Tom joined a swimming club. At first, he couldn't swim at all. He was nervous and often felt tired. His coach and friends helped him a lot. Every week, he practiced for 2 hours. After 3 months, Tom could swim 50 meters. On the club's competition day, he even got the 3rd prize. He felt proud of himself. That was his favorite growing-up moment.
The swimming club met twice a week after school. At first, Tom often touched the wall with his feet instead of his hands, and he breathed at the wrong time. But the coach corrected him patiently, and his club friends cheered him on. Three months of steady practice turned a nervous boy into a confident swimmer. When he stood on the small prize stage, his parents were in the crowd and smiled with pride. Tom now tells his little brother that practice, not talent, grows up.
passageZh:
去年汤姆加入游泳俱乐部。起初他根本不会游，紧张又常觉得累。教练和朋友帮了他很多。他每周练习2小时，三个月后能游50米。俱乐部比赛那天他还得了三等奖，为自己骄傲。那是他最爱的成长瞬间。
游泳俱乐部每周放学后活动两次。起初汤姆常碰到脚而不是手，换气时机也不对。但教练耐心纠正，俱乐部朋友为他加油。三个月稳定练习把紧张的男孩变成自信的游泳者。站上小小的领奖台时，父母在人群中骄傲地笑。汤姆现在告诉弟弟：让人成长的是练习，而不是天赋。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U1测试卷笔试（提高卷·阅读判断改写）

title: Lucy and her cat Mimi
passage:
When I was 7, I wanted a pet cat. But Mom said I was too young to look after it. I was sad. Then I tried to show I could be responsible: I cleaned my room every day, and helped feed our neighbor's dog. When I was 9, Mom bought me a cat. I named it Mimi. Now I feed Mimi, clean its bed and play with it every day. I know growing up means learning to take care of others.
Looking after a pet teaches children real responsibility. After getting Mimi, Lucy made a simple chart on the wall: feed her in the morning, clean the litter box in the evening, and play for ten minutes every day. When Mimi was sick once, Lucy sat by her bed and gave her medicine carefully. The family doctor said the cat grew healthy again because of Lucy's care. Lucy now understands that loving an animal means showing up every single day, not just on the happy days.
passageZh:
我7岁时想要一只宠物猫，妈妈说我太小不会照顾，我很难过。于是我努力表现出责任感：每天打扫房间，帮着喂邻居的狗。9岁时妈妈给我买了只猫，取名咪咪。现在我每天喂咪咪、清理它的窝、陪它玩。我懂得成长意味着学会照顾别人。
照顾宠物教会孩子真正的责任。得到咪咪后，露西在墙上做了简单表格：早上喂食、晚上清理猫窝、每天陪玩十分钟。有次咪咪生病，露西守在它床边认真喂药。家庭医生说，正是露西的照料让猫恢复健康。露西现在懂得，爱一只动物意味着每天都在，而不只是在开心的日子。

title: An unforgettable survival camp
passage: Last month, I joined a survival camp. On the first day, I felt worried because I didn't know anyone. The training was challenging—we learned to start a fire and find clean water. But my teammates helped me a lot. On the fourth day, we cooked hot pot together. I made vegetable dumplings, and everyone said they were delicious! We also watched a video about plant growth: a seed sprouts, grows leaves, and finally becomes a big tree. After the camp, I felt confident. It was an unforgettable growing-up moment.
passageZh: 上个月我参加生存营。第一天我担心，因为谁也不认识。训练有挑战——学生火、找干净水，但队友帮了我很多。第四天我们一起煮火锅，我做了蔬菜饺子，大家都说好吃！我们还看了植物生长视频：种子发芽、长叶，最后长成大树。营后我变得自信，这是难忘的成长瞬间。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U1测试卷笔试（基础卷·阅读选择）

title: Lily grows up at camp
passage:
Hello! I'm Lily. Last year, I was 7. I was short and shy. I couldn't ride a bike or swim. I wanted to be brave, so I joined a summer camp. At the camp, I practiced riding a bike every morning. I also learnt to swim. At first, I was nervous. But my friends helped me. By the end of the camp, I could ride a bike and swim well. I was very proud. Now I'm 8. I'm tall and confident. Growing up is wonderful!
After the camp, Lily wrote about her summer in her diary. She drew a small bike beside the words I can ride, and a little wave beside the words I can swim. Her teacher read the diary in class and praised her growth. Lily realised that growing up is not about being tall alone; it is about trying, failing, getting up again and finally believing in yourself. She looks forward to next year's camp and the new things she will learn there.
passageZh:
你好，我是莉莉。去年我7岁，又矮又害羞，不会骑车也不会游泳。我想变勇敢，就参加了夏令营。在营里我每天早上练骑车，还学了游泳。起初紧张，但朋友帮我。到营结束时，我骑车和游泳都很好，非常自豪。现在我8岁，又高又自信。成长真美好！
营后莉莉把夏天写进日记，在“我会骑车”旁边画了辆小自行车，在“我会游泳”旁边画了朵小浪花。老师在班上读了她的日记，表扬她的成长。莉莉意识到，成长不只是长高，而是尝试、失败、重新站起，最终相信自己。她期待明年的营地和那里要学的新事物。

title: What volunteers do
passage:
Volunteers help people in need. They go to care homes to visit the old, go to children's homes to play with kids, and clean up parks to make the city beautiful. Volunteers don't get money, but they feel happy because they can help others. Many people join volunteer activities to learn to care for others.
Volunteers come from every age group: students, office workers, retirees and even families with children. They give their free time and do not ask for pay. At weekends, you can see volunteers cleaning the streets, helping at a book fair, or feeding stray animals. Being a volunteer teaches us kindness, patience and teamwork. When everyone shares a little love, our neighbourhood becomes a warmer and better place for all.
passageZh:
志愿者帮助有需要的人。他们去敬老院看望老人，去儿童之家陪孩子玩，打扫公园让城市变美。志愿者不拿报酬，但因为能帮助别人而快乐。许多人参加志愿活动，学习关心他人。
志愿者来自各个年龄层：学生、上班族、退休老人，甚至带孩子的家庭。他们献出空闲时间，不求报酬。周末你能看到志愿者打扫街道、在书展帮忙、或喂流浪动物。做志愿教会我们善良、耐心和团队合作。当每个人都献出一点爱，社区就会成为更温暖、更美好的地方。

title: A kind act at the bus stop
passage:
One afternoon, Tom saw an old man carrying heavy bags at the bus stop. The old man could not walk easily. Tom ran over and helped the old man carry his bags to the bus. The old man thanked Tom many times. Tom felt proud of himself and knew that small acts of kindness can help others a lot.
After helping the old man onto the bus, Tom watched him sit down comfortably. The old man smiled and patted Tom's shoulder. On his way home, Tom thought about his own grandfather, who lived alone in another city. He decided to visit his grandfather more often and carry his shopping bags whenever possible. A small act, Tom realised, does not need money, just a kind heart and two willing hands.
passageZh:
一天下午，汤姆在公交站看见一位老人拎着沉重的袋子，走路很吃力。汤姆跑过去帮老人把袋子拎到公交车上。老人多次感谢汤姆。汤姆为自己骄傲，也懂得小小的善举能帮别人很多。
帮老人上了公交车后，汤姆看着他安稳坐下。老人笑着拍拍汤姆的肩膀。回家路上，汤姆想起独自住在另一座城市的爷爷，决定更常去看爷爷，能帮拎购物袋时就帮一把。汤姆意识到，小小的善举不需要花钱，只需要一颗善心和一双愿意出力的手。

title: A visit to the care home
passage:
Last weekend, we went to the care home. We read books to the old people and helped them clean their rooms. The old people were very happy, and we felt warm and meaningful. We took photos and will make a photo album for them. We will go there again next month.
The care home is a clean and quiet place where old people live who have no family to look after them. On that Saturday, the old grandparents sat in the sun and listened to our reading. Some of them held our hands and told us stories about their own youth. When it was time to leave, they walked us to the door and said thank you again and again. We all felt that a simple visit can warm an old person's whole day.

title: Learn from Lei Feng
passage:
Lei Feng was a kind man. He always helped people. He was like a bright star. He taught us to help others. Many people learned from him. We should do volunteer work too. We can help at a care home or clean up a park. Everyone can make a difference.
Lei Feng was a soldier in the People's Liberation Army in the 1960s. He did many small good things every day: he helped his comrades clean their rooms, gave his own money to people in trouble, and always put others first. He died very young, but his story still lives on. Every year on 5 March, people in China learn from Lei Feng and do volunteer work to help those around them. His example tells us that a warm heart can make a big difference.

雷锋是20世纪60年代人民解放军的一名战士。他每天做许多小小的好事：帮战友打扫房间、把自己的钱给有困难的人，总是先人后己。他很年轻就去世了，但他的故事流传至今。每年3月5日，中国人向雷锋学习，做志愿工作帮助身边的人。他的榜样告诉我们，一颗温暖的心能带来很大改变。

title: Sam at the children's home
passage:

We also gave them some books and toys. I learned that helping others can make both others and ourselves happy.
The children's home looks after boys and girls who have no parents nearby. Our activity lasted the whole afternoon. Besides reading and games, we taught the children some simple English songs and drew pictures together. Before leaving, each child received a warm hug. My classmate Tom said he wanted to come back every month. Helping children in need makes us remember that kindness never goes to waste.

title: World Book Day
passage:
World Book Day is on 23 April every year. It's a day for people to show their love of books and reading. Children celebrate it in many fun ways. They sit down and read their favourite books, dress up as book characters, act out their favourite stories, paint pictures for books, and make bookmarks for family and friends. All the activities make reading more interesting.
World Book Day was started by UNESCO to encourage people, especially children, to open a book every day. Many schools hold a reading week, a book swap market, or a reading corner on that day. Children may dress up as their favourite character, such as Harry Potter or a pirate, and walk in a parade. Some libraries give every child a small book as a gift. The day reminds us that books are free friends who teach us about the world without leaving our seat.
passageZh:
世界读书日在每年4月23日，是人们表达对书籍和阅读之爱的日子。孩子们用许多有趣方式庆祝：读最喜欢的书、装扮成书中角色、表演最喜欢的故事、为书画画、为亲友做书签。所有活动让阅读更有趣。
世界读书日由联合国教科文组织发起，鼓励人们尤其是孩子每天翻开一本书。许多学校在这一天举办阅读周、旧书交换市场或阅读角。孩子们可以装扮成最喜欢的角色，如哈利·波特或海盗，参加游行。一些图书馆还给每个孩子送一本小书作礼物。这一天提醒我们：书是免费的朋友，不用离开座位就能教我们认识世界。

title: The Secret Garden
passage:
The Secret Garden is a great book by Frances Hodgson Burnett. Mary, a 10-year-old girl, lost her parents and lived with her uncle. She was unhappy and often angry at first. Then she found a secret garden and met Dickon. They worked together to make the garden alive. Mary became friendly and kind, and she also helped her cousin Colin get well. This book is about friends and love, and it shows the power of nature.
Mary moved to the big old house after her parents died of illness in India. At first she was a difficult, lonely child who spoke to no one. One morning she found a hidden garden behind a high wall, locked for years. With Dickon, a kind boy who knew plants, she cleared the grass and planted roses. As the garden bloomed, Mary bloomed too: she became cheerful, polite and caring. The garden also helped her sick cousin Colin stand up and walk again. The Secret Garden shows how nature and friendship can heal a sad heart.
passageZh:
《秘密花园》是弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特写的好书。10岁女孩玛丽失去父母，和叔叔住一起，起初不开心、常生气。后来她发现秘密花园，遇见迪肯，一起让花园恢复生机。玛丽变得友善善良，还帮表弟科林康复。这本书讲友谊与爱，也展现自然的力量。
玛丽父母在印度病逝后，她搬到这座又大又旧的房子。起初她孤僻难相处，不和人说话。一天早晨她在高墙后发现一座紧锁多年的秘密花园。她和懂植物的善良男孩迪肯一起除草、种玫瑰。花园绽放时玛丽也变得开朗、有礼、体贴。花园还帮助生病的表弟科林重新站起来走路。《秘密花园》展现自然与友谊如何治愈一颗悲伤的心。

title: The horse library
passage:
The horse library is a special library. It comes every week, rain or shine. When Mum was young, her library only came once a month. It was a small library with not many books, but Mum loved it. Books gave her a lot of fun. Today, the horse library brings not only books but also joy to us.
A horse library usually rides out to villages that have no bookshop on the road. The librarian puts books in two big bags on the horse's back and brings them to different houses every week. Children wait by the road with their reading cards, choose a book, and return the old one. Long ago, Mum also borrowed books from this kind of mobile library when she was a little girl. Now she takes her own child to it, and that passing on of joy is the magic of reading.
passageZh:
马背图书馆是个特别的图书馆，无论晴雨每周都来。妈妈小时候，图书馆一个月才来一次，书不多，可妈妈很喜欢，书给她很多乐趣。如今马背图书馆不仅带来书，还带给我们快乐。
马背图书馆通常骑到路边没有书店的村子。管理员把书装在两个大袋子里驮在马背上，每周送到不同人家。孩子们拿着借书卡在路边等待，选一本书、还回旧书。很久以前，妈妈小时候也从这种流动图书馆借书。如今她带自己的孩子去，这份快乐的传递正是阅读的魔力。

title: Sam and the street library
passage:
Sam loves reading and he often goes to the street library near his home. The street library is small but nice. There are many types of books there, like history books, adventure fiction and fantasy stories. Last weekend, Sam read a history book about Chinese nation there. He wrote a book report after reading it. He said the street library brings him a lot of fun and he can learn a lot from books.
The street library is a small wooden box on the sidewalk where people leave books for others to take. Sam goes there every Saturday afternoon. Last weekend he chose a history book about the Chinese nation and read it under the old tree nearby. After finishing it, he wrote a short book report for his class and put the book back for the next reader. He believes that sharing a book is like sharing a piece of knowledge, and it makes reading a kind of friendship between strangers.

title: Why learn history?
passage:
Learning history is very important for us. We can learn about the things from the past, like ancient food, old buildings and great events. We know how people lived a long time ago and how our country developed. We can also learn the spirit of great people, like Fan Jinshi who protected history, and the Red Army who had the never-give-up spirit. History tells us many great lessons, and it helps us to live a better life today.
History is all around us, not only in textbooks. The old bridge in our town, the noodles our grandfathers ate, and the festivals we still celebrate all carry history. Studying the past helps us understand why our country looks the way it does, and why people live as they do. Great people such as Fan Jinshi protected our cultural relics so we can see them today. The Red Army's never-give-up spirit still gives us courage when we face hard work. Knowing history makes us wiser and more grateful.
passageZh:
学习历史对我们很重要。我们能了解过去的事物，如古代食物、古老建筑和重大事件，了解古人如何生活、国家如何发展。我们还能学习伟人精神，如保护历史的樊锦诗、有永不放弃精神的红军。历史给我们很多宝贵教训，帮助我们今天过上更好的生活。
历史就在我们身边，不只是课本里。镇上的老桥、祖父吃过的面条、我们仍庆祝的节日，都承载历史。学习过去帮助我们理解国家为何如此、人们为何这样生活。樊锦诗这样的伟人保护文物，让我们今天还能看到。红军永不放弃的精神仍在我们面对困难时给我们勇气。了解历史让我们更明智、更感恩。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U4测试卷笔试（基础卷·阅读选择）

title: Fan Jinshi protects Dunhuang
passage:
Fan Jinshi is a great woman who protects Dunhuang's art. When she first went to Dunhuang, life was difficult, and there were problems everywhere in the caves. But she loved the beautiful paintings on the walls. She and other people took photos of the paintings and used digital ways to show them. In this way, more people can enjoy the art, and the paintings in the caves are well protected. Fan Jinshi spent her life protecting Dunhuang's history, and we should learn from her.
Dunhuang lies in the Gobi Desert in northwest China. The Mogao Caves hold thousands of ancient wall paintings and sculptures made over a thousand years. When Fan Jinshi arrived in 1963, the caves were dusty and crumbling, and strong winds damaged the art every year. She spent her whole life living there, studying the paintings and raising money to protect them. Her team used digital cameras and computers to record the murals, so everyone in the world can see them online. People call her the Daughter of Dunhuang because she gave Dunhuang her youth and her heart.
passageZh:
樊锦诗是守护敦煌艺术的伟大女性。初到敦煌时生活艰难，洞窟里到处是问题，但她热爱墙上美丽的壁画。她和别人给壁画拍照，用数字方式展示，这样更多人能欣赏艺术，洞窟壁画也得到良好保护。樊锦诗一生守护敦煌历史，我们应向她学习。
敦煌位于中国西北戈壁。莫高窟藏有上千年来创作的数千幅古代壁画和雕塑。1963年樊锦诗初到时，洞窟积尘剥落，每年大风损害壁画。她一生住在那里，研究壁画、筹款保护。她的团队用数码相机和电脑记录壁画，让全世界都能在线看到。人们称她“敦煌女儿”，因为她把青春和心都给了敦煌。

title: The ancient dumpling on the Silk Road
passage:
Xinjiang was an important place on the ancient Silk Road. It was near the border between China and other countries, so people from East and West met there for trade. A long time ago, people from the Central Plains went to Xinjiang along the Silk Road and brought dumplings there. The ancient dumpling found in Xinjiang dates back to the Tang Dynasty. It's in the shape of a new moon and looks just like the dumplings we eat today.
The Silk Road was a long trade route linking China with Central Asia, West Asia and Europe. Along it, people carried silk, tea, spices and food between East and West. Xinjiang sat right in the middle of this road, so it became a busy meeting place for travellers and traders. The ancient dumpling found there shows that food also travelled along the road and took on local tastes. Today we can still taste that long history on our dinner table.
passageZh:
新疆是古丝绸之路上的重要地点，靠近中国与他国边境，东西方人在那里贸易。很久以前，中原人沿丝绸之路到新疆，把饺子带到那里。在新疆发现的古代饺子可追溯到唐朝，呈新月形，看起来和今天吃的饺子一模一样。
丝绸之路是连接中国与中亚、西亚、欧洲的漫长商路。人们沿路在东西方之间运输丝绸、茶叶、香料和食物。新疆正处在这条路中央，成为旅行者和商人繁忙的交汇地。在那里发现的古代饺子说明食物也沿路传播，并融入当地口味。今天我们仍能在餐桌上品尝那段悠久历史。
source: 外研版（2024新教材·三年级起点）；五下U4测试卷笔试（基础卷·阅读填空改写）

title: A day at the National Museum
passage: Yesterday, I went to the National Museum of China with my parents. I saw many interesting things from the past, and the most interesting one was an ancient dumpling from Xinjiang. It was a great day!

title: Mr Green's missing wallet
passage: Last Friday, Mr. Green couldn't find his wallet. He was very worried because there was some money and his ID card in it. He looked for it everywhere in his house—on the table, in the drawer, under the bed, but he didn't find it. Then his son Jack said, "Dad, let's think carefully. Where did you put it last time?" Mr. Green thought for a moment and said, "I put it in my coat pocket when I came back home yesterday evening." Jack checked the coat pocket and found the wallet there. Mr. Green was very thankful to Jack.
